title: Franklin Baker Run for Coconut Farmers 2026 Davao Review
seo_title: Franklin Baker Run Davao 2026 Review | Philippines Charity Race
meta_description: Franklin Baker Run for Coconut Farmers 2026 Davao: September 20 at Franklin Baker Plant. A charity run for coconut farming communities.
dek: Set for 20 September 2026 at the Franklin Baker Daron Plant in Davao City, this charity run supports coconut farming communities.
verdict: The Franklin Baker Run for Coconut Farmers is a charity road race with genuine social-purpose roots — organised by Franklin Baker, one of the world's largest coconut-product companies, to support the farming communities at the heart of the Philippine coconut industry. Held at the company's Daron Plant in Davao City. Four distances (21K, 10K, 5K, 3K). The coconut-farmer advocacy gives the race purpose-driven character that distinguishes it from commercial events. A meaningful Philippine race with social-impact credentials.
